data.name: Fitriyyah
data.gender_notes: Fitriyyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'fitra', meaning 'natural disposition' or 'innate character'. In Islamic belief, the term is used to describe the inherent goodness within all human beings, as outlined in the Quran. The name Fitriyyah carries the meaning “Pure, innocent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fitriyyah usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, innocent and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fitriyyah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
